title: What ragtime was like
summary: Asked about ragtime, Morris says it is jumping music like rock and roll, and that Kid Rena was hot.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: What the word "jazz" means: origins, Dixieland and labels

blocks.x: Yeah, I was wondering, when you were a little boy, what was this ragtime music like then? Was it the same as what they called Dixieland Jams?

Yeah, that's what you call ragtime. You just jump when you talk about ragtime. All you got to do is make a motion. But now they got this kind of music now. An old man would fall down trying to dance that now. Oh, yeah. Yes. Can you wrap that up? I'll wrap that up.
Can you draw some people on the talking?

Well, now, uh... Hey, you want a clean piece of paper? No, that's all right. No, that's as good as I can't get to throw this over. Now, ragtime, who were the outstanding bands, you know, for the head music, the other music?
Well, I'll tell you the truth. Kid Rennie was pretty hot.
When you were a little boy?

No, well, Rennie was big then. It's the same thing what they got now. Rennie was playing with the city. The ragtime band, that's the same thing what they call, uh... What they call, uh... Not jitterbug. Jitterbug. Rock and roll? Yeah, rock and roll music. Now, that's the same thing. Rock and roll is mostly a part of most... Just jumping and jigging.
